statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ remains in the weekend closure, so current Tail stays low while geopolitical and energy Stress is extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below the block threshold; the nearest conditional WATCH concentration is the Sunday Globex reopening.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low; reopening carries a narrow conditional WATCH window
body: No live NQ price path is available during the weekend closure. Iran sanctions escalation and severely disrupted Strait of Hormuz traffic keep Stress extreme, but those headlines are not counted as observed one-way Nasdaq structure. Conditional Tail rises at the Sunday reopening and remains below the block threshold unless persistent extension with weak retracements is observed.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 published hourly assessments stayed EA_ON with Tail at 16%. Stress was extreme at 96-97% while NQ remained closed and weekend geopolitical headlines did not create observable price-path evidence.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low during the weekend closure. Conditional risk rises to WATCH at the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening, then decays if price discovery is orderly. Monday adds CFNAI, CFSEC, the U.S. cash open and a 18:00 UTC Treasury press conference on Iran sanctions and Treasury measures.

forecast.analysis: Early overnight risk remains conditional on the quality of post-open retracements. Orderly range development would lower Tail; repeated extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate that path.
With the initial reopening phase passing, Tail falls below WATCH if price discovery is two-sided. Geopolitical and oil uncertainty still keeps Stress extreme.
Overnight risk normalizes conditionally as the reopening impulse ages. Persistent Hormuz headlines remain a Stress driver, but Tail stays low absent renewed directional efficiency.
Asian-session transition risk is modest. A stable NQ range and cross-asset stabilization would keep Tail low; a fresh geopolitical discontinuity would raise Stress first.
Early European hours are modeled as low Tail if overnight retracements remain available. Oil and long-yield sensitivity remain background amplifiers rather than assumed direction.
European price discovery remains conditionally normal. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding at an extreme with repeated failed retracements and aligned cross-asset pressure.
Mid-European trading carries no scheduled U.S. catalyst. The risk path remains dominated by observed overnight structure and persistent energy/geopolitical Stress.
Late-European trading remains low Tail under a two-sided-path assumption. A widening directional gap into U.S. premarket would be the principal invalidation.

U.S. premarket approaches without a major release in this hour. Tail remains low unless overnight direction becomes increasingly efficient and corroborated by rates, volatility and technology breadth.
Premarket positioning becomes more relevant as the Chicago Fed release approaches. Tail rises only slightly because the event has not printed and no future direction is assumed.
CFNAI is scheduled at 12:30 UTC. Event proximity raises Stress and conditional Tail modestly; the release itself does not imply a one-way Nasdaq reaction.
U.S. premarket approaches the CFNAI release. Tail rises only slightly because the event has not printed and no future direction is assumed.
CFNAI is scheduled at 12:30 UTC. Event proximity raises Stress and conditional Tail modestly; the release itself does not imply a one-way Nasdaq reaction.
The U.S. cash open occurs at 13:30 UTC. Tail rises to WATCH because opening-auction continuation can matter, but persistence and pullback quality must be observed after the bell.
CFSEC is scheduled at 14:00 UTC while the first cash-session hour is developing. Tail peaks at WATCH conditionally; a block requires sustained extension with weak or failed retracements.
Late-morning U.S. risk falls if opening volatility mean-reverts. Continued one-way breadth, yields and megacap alignment would be the main reason for Tail to remain elevated.
Midday conditions are modeled as more two-sided absent fresh catalysts. Tail remains near WATCH only if the opening move continues to resist meaningful retracement.

Attention shifts toward the 18:00 UTC Treasury press conference. Tail rises conditionally because sanctions and long-bond policy can transmit through oil and yields, not because an outcome is assumed.
Treasury Secretary Bessent's press conference is scheduled at 18:00 UTC. Tail reaches WATCH for potential oil/yield repricing; actual content and price response remain unobserved until then.
The first post-press-conference hour remains a conditional WATCH window. Tail stays elevated only if market reaction becomes directionally persistent across NQ, yields, oil and volatility.
The U.S. cash close is the final forecast hour. Tail remains WATCH conditionally if late-day positioning is one-way; an orderly close would support rapid normalization afterward.
